items.english: I had no idea what I wanted to do with my life
items.chinese: 我不知道我這輩子想做什麼，

items.english: and no idea how college was going to help me figure it out.
items.chinese: 也不知道大學能如何幫我找到答案。

items.english: And here I was spending all of the money my parents had saved their entire life.
items.chinese: 而我卻在這裡花光了我父母一輩子的積蓄。

items.english: So I decided to drop out and trust that it would all work out OK.
items.chinese: 所以我決定休學，並相信一切最終都會順利。

items.english: It was pretty scary at the time,
but looking back it was one of the best decisions I ever made.
items.chinese: 但現在回頭看，這是我做過最棒的決定之一。

items.english: The minute I dropped out I could stop taking the required classes that didn't interest me,
items.chinese: 休學的那一刻起，我就可以停止去上那些我沒興趣的必修課，

items.english: and begin dropping in on the ones that looked interesting.
items.chinese: 開始去旁聽那些看起來很有趣的課。
這一切並不全都是那麼浪漫。

items.english: I didn't have a dorm room, so I slept on the floor in friends' rooms,
items.chinese: 我沒有宿舍可以住，所以我睡在朋友房間的地板上，

items.english: I returned coke bottles for the 5 cent deposits to buy food with,
items.chinese: 我靠著回收可樂空瓶賺取 5 分錢的押金來買食物，

items.english: and I would walk the 7 miles across town every Sunday night
items.chinese: 每個星期天晚上，我會徒步走 7 英里穿過整個城市，

items.english: to get one good meal a week at the Hare Krishna temple.
items.chinese: 只為了能在哈瑞奎師那神廟吃上一頓每週一次的好料。
